---
name: trap-inline-code
description: "a labelled lint-benchmark page"
ocd: 2026-01-01
lmd: 2026-01-02
---
Never write `^ATOM-DEAD-BEEF ⟦keywords: k⟧` — use ASCII brackets. A literal `[^99]`
in prose is not a footnote reference either.

```
^ATOM-CAFE-F00D ⟦keywords: k⟧
[^98]: a fenced example definition
```
